app.usage.text:
MuseDesktop {0} — command line

  MuseDesktop.exe [options] [musedesktop:// link]

Options:
  --profile <id>   Start in (or switch to) the named profile.
                   On a running instance the switch asks first, like the menu.
  --background     Start quietly in the tray (used by Start with Windows).
  --home           Open at the Muse home page.
  --settings       Open the Settings window.
  --downloads      Open the Downloads window.
  --dictate        Open MuseDesktop ready for voice input (Quick dictate).
  --safe-mode      Start at the home page and skip the update check.
                   The app lock still applies. Launch-time only: it has
                   no effect on an instance that is already running.
  --help           Show this text and exit.
  --version        Show the MuseDesktop version and exit.

Links (registered for the current Windows user):
  musedesktop://open            Show the window
  musedesktop://home            Go to the Muse home page
  musedesktop://settings        Open Settings
  musedesktop://downloads       Open Downloads
  musedesktop://help            Open Help & troubleshooting
  musedesktop://profile/<id>    Start in (or switch to) a profile

Links can only name these actions — a musedesktop:// link can never
carry a web address or open an arbitrary page. When MuseDesktop is
already running, options and links are handed to the running instance;
while it is locked, they wait and apply after you unlock.
